entity.summary: Indonesian digital-asset trading platform providing cryptocurrency purchase, sale, wallet transfers, and portfolio access alongside other investment products.
entity.notes: The current Nanovest site identifies PT Tumbuh Bersama Nano as operator of its crypto-asset trading and transaction platform and states that the operator is licensed and supervised by OJK. OJK's published Digital Financial Asset Trading Provider list identifies PT Tumbuh Bersama Nano (Nanovest) under registration S-8/D.07/2025. The broader Nanovest app also offers foreign-stock and digital-gold products; HEI records only the centralized crypto trading function and does not classify those other products as exchange activity.

evidence.title: Nanovest digital asset trading platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party site identifies Nanovest as a digital-asset marketplace and PT Tumbuh Bersama Nano as the OJK-licensed operator facilitating crypto-asset transactions.

evidence.title: List of Digital Financial Asset Trading Providers
evidence.notes: OJK's published provider list identifies PT Tumbuh Bersama Nano (Nanovest) under registration S-8/D.07/2025. Current first-party material continues to state OJK licensing and supervision in 2026.
